notes.source: A read the server answered and refused (#658, ADR-0031): the title both variants share and the retry. The offline face is not here - it is `NeedsConnection`, which owns its own title - so an unreachable server and a refusal keep the two different answers the site gives them.
notes.gate: `npm run check:copy` fails a stale generated output, and `npm run check:parity` fails a key `read-failure.tsx` does not render.
